name: desktop-mods
description: Antony's Claude Code Desktop mods in one: context ring in the prompt footer, git Commit/Push bar, usage meter, and next-step suggestions.

contextRing.title: Context ring
contextRing.description: Draw the context window's fill as a ring in the prompt footer.

contextLimit.title: Context ring full at (tokens)
contextLimit.description: Tokens at which the ring is full. 0 uses the auto-compact window, or the model's window when auto-compact is off.

gitBar.title: Git bar
gitBar.description: Commit and Push buttons, branch picker and diff count above the prompt.

usageMeter.title: Usage meter
usageMeter.description: Plan-limit %, tokens and $ in the band and the /burn pane. Needs the collector (deploy/install.ps1).

nextSteps.title: Next-step suggestions
nextSteps.description: After each turn, suggest up to three next prompts above the input.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip next-step suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the next-step suggester which skills and slash commands this session has.
